text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year. I owe you a lot for your assistance last year.
choice_data_list: Happy New Year to you too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… I'll be counting on you this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: This year will present still greater challenges than those we have faced so far.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I trust you are well aware of the lofty ideals I aspire toward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you ready for what awaits us?
choice_data_list: Let's go get that Triple Tiara.
Let's go get that Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, it seems you are indeed prepared.
choice_data_list: Your dreams are my dreams too.
Your dreams are my dreams too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, well… You really are something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After reaffirming our goals, we take a little breather.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You know, considering the season, don't you think you're acting a bit too "business as usual"?
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Look at your office. Not a single New Year's decoration in sight.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Seasonal events provide color and variety to our daily lives. If you wish to have a fulfilling year, you should pay them more attention.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Holidays and celebrations are highly valued at Tracen Academy. It would be best for you to show some holiday spirit as well.
choice_data_list: S-sorry about that…
S-sorry about that…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Surely there's some New Year's tradition you enjoy? Go on, name it.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Just this once, I'll assist you with whatever activity you choose. I hope you realize how rare an opportunity this is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's activities, huh? I suppose I can think of a few options…
choice_data_list: Maybe we can put up a big New Year's decoration?
Let's make some traditional New Year's mochi soup!
How about some New Year's calligraphy?
How about some New Year's calligraphy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: New Year's activities, huh? I suppose I can think of a few options…
choice_data_list: Maybe we can put up a big New Year's decoration?
Let's make some traditional New Year's mochi soup!
How about some New Year's calligraphy?
How about some New Year's calligraphy?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Visuals are not a bad way to get into the holiday spirit. Even if "big" leaves a lot up to interpretation…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I think the academy has some unused decorations lying around. We can liven things up if we place them here.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Come on, then—let's get going. The decorations aren't going to grow legs and walk here themselves.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Once all the decorations are in place, I look around at our handiwork.
choice_data_list: It's so… New Year's-y!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Almost too much so, if I'm being honest. But yes, I suppose it's worth a passing grade.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you see now how a simple visual change can affect one's mood? I'm feeling ready to give the year's first training session my all.
choice_data_list: Then why don't we get down to that training session right now?
Then why don't we get down to that training session right now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh. Now there's an idea.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Revitalized, we head off to our training session with fresh minds.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You… haven't had any yet?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Unbelievable… Does this holiday mean nothing to you?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The year doesn't begin until you've had some mochi soup! We must remedy this at once.
choice_data_list: Is it really that big of a deal?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course it is! Now tell me where you were born. We need to make sure we make you the right local variant.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After being thorougly interrogated, I get to eat Air Groove's homemade New Year's mochi soup. In all honesty, I feel quite lucky.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not a bad suggestion. Writing our aspirations for the year is a good method to get us motivated.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: We have the necessary materials in the student council office. I'll allow you to use some.
choice_data_list: You ready?
You ready?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course. I do this every year with the student council. So what are you going to write?
choice_data_list: "Win the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh… Me too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Using the brushes and ink Air Groove brought, we each write "Win the Triple Tiara."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though the messages we write are the same, Air Groove's brush strokes are much bolder and more beautiful than mine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her penmanship clearly reflects her character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as we're preparing to begin the year's first training session…

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: There she is!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! Trainer! We've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Reporters, huh? It appears they've already received permission from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: I was hoping to ask some questions about your plans for your classic year!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: Your fans are atwitter about the possibility of you participating in the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Do you mind if I take a moment to respond, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove double-checks with me. Our plans have been set, so I nod in affirmation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let me take this opportunity to make an announcement. In my classic year, I intend to pursue the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: W-wow, the Tiara tour! What a scoop! Then that means…

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: You'll be running in the Japanese Oaks too, right?! Are you aiming to continue your mother's legacy?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: For the time being, I am focusing all of my efforts on the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I intend to make my intentions for the Tiara tour quite clear through my performance in that race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Now, I have a training session to attend to, so if you'll excuse me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so begins Air Groove's classic year—a fresh new year filled with hopes and challenges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara awaits, and first up is the Oka Sho!
